symptom: System enters FREEZE but mandatory FreezeIncident/AuditLog persistence fails or is skipped.
root_cause: FREEZE transition helper is in-memory only; caller fails to perform required SERIALIZABLE persistence transaction or persistence itself fails.
failed_approach: Treat buildFreezeEnvelope() as complete freeze handling.
Downgrade missing incident/audit persistence to optional telemetry warning.
why_failed: FREEZE without durable incident/audit evidence breaks traceability and source law.
Current worker source explicitly keeps mandatory audit persistence failure visible.
successful_recovery: Remain visibly frozen/failed.
Surface MANDATORY_AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_FAILURE.
Repair persistence dependency before legal recovery.
prevention: All production FREEZE callers must persist incident + audit in SERIALIZABLE transaction.
Never convert mandatory audit persistence failure into warning-only.

symptom: Malformed or widened queue payload reaches worker execution or carries fabricated swarm/evidence fields.
root_cause: Queue payload not validated against canonical DirectiveJobSchema at both producer and consumer boundaries.
failed_approach: Trust API-produced internal payload.
Widen queue payload with agent IDs/evidence/confidence/timestamps before real swarm boundary.
why_failed: Internal origin is not a trust guarantee.
Fabricated fields contaminate later JUDGE/LAW evidence.
successful_recovery: Reject with SCHEMA_VIOLATION before state/progress/swarm execution.
Route affected run to explicit failure/FREEZE handling.
prevention: validateProducerPayload before enqueue.
validateWorkerPayload before consume.
Keep queue wire contract narrow.

symptom: Old queued work executes after its legal stale-job TTL.
root_cause: Worker does not compare enqueue timestamp against configured stale_job_ttl_ms at consume boundary.
failed_approach: Assume BullMQ execution timeout enforces stale-job policy.
Let stale jobs execute and rely on downstream timeout.
why_failed: Queue age is a separate validity boundary from execution duration.
successful_recovery: Mark job EXPIRED before state/progress/swarm execution.
Do not run authoritative pipeline for expired payload.
prevention: Perform consume-boundary TTL validation using queue enqueue clock semantics.

symptom: Same directive/run executes swarm or commits output more than once.
root_cause: Dispatch ownership/idempotency claim is missing or duplicate delivery is treated as new work.
failed_approach: Rely only on queue delivery semantics.
Retry failed/duplicate job without durable claim boundary.
why_failed: Queue delivery may duplicate; authoritative side effects must be deduplicated separately.
successful_recovery: Use durable claimDirectiveDispatch.
Acknowledge COMPLETED as idempotent success and PROCESSING duplicate as CANCELLED/no re-execution.
prevention: Keep durable dispatch claim independent of transport retry/delivery.

symptom: Worker runs against Redis with appendonly disabled.
root_cause: Redis durability configuration is not verified at startup.
failed_approach: Assume Redis deployment is durable because Redis is reachable.
why_failed: Reachability does not prove durable queue semantics.
successful_recovery: Emit critical WORKER_DOWN alarm.
Print FREEZE reason and terminate worker startup.
regression_tests: DOC-E E7 queue worker readiness should exercise real Redis AOF.
prevention: assertRedisAof() before worker begins consuming.

symptom: Candidate reaches durable final output despite failed release gate.
root_cause: Worker commits output before prereleaseGate or ignores one of independent gate failures.
failed_approach: Treat JUDGE candidate as final authority.
Commit output before LAW passes.
Use provider confidence directly as release authority.
why_failed: JUDGE computes candidate metrics; LAW alone authorizes release.
Source requires one verified output or no release.
successful_recovery: recordPipelineRunFailure with blockingLayer LAW_PRERELEASE.
Mark run REJECTED/FREEZE and do not commit final output.
prevention: Keep final durable output commit strictly after LAW approval.

symptom: Blob content does not match stored content hash.
root_cause: Tampered/corrupt content or wrong hash accepted without verification.
failed_approach: Trust blob path/reference alone.
Commit metadata without verifying content hash.
why_failed: Path existence does not prove content integrity.
successful_recovery: Reject commit/content as hash mismatch.
Preserve prior immutable revision/history.
prevention: verifyContentHash before authoritative commit.

symptom: Commit chain contains previousVersion gap/fork/inconsistent lineage.
root_cause: Ordering/previousVersion constraints are bypassed or corrupted.
failed_approach: Treat revision row existence as sufficient lineage proof.
why_failed: History must be reconstructable and append-only.
successful_recovery: Reject/flag chain integrity failure.
Do not rewrite old commits to repair history.
regression_tests: Vault chain/OCC tests; current dedicated chain test mapping should be added if absent.
prevention: DB uniqueness plus verifyChain() before trust-sensitive operations.

symptom: Same failing playbook repeats indefinitely and consumes resources.
root_cause: Recovery attempts are not bounded or success does not reset attempt state.
failed_approach: Retry forever.
Treat remediation failure as reason for immediate identical retry.
why_failed: Unbounded recovery becomes a failure amplifier.
successful_recovery: After configured attempts, escalate to owner.
Reset attempt counter only after successful remediation.
prevention: Every playbook declares escalateAfterAttempts.

symptom: Process is terminated without a final tamper-evident state marker/snapshot.
root_cause: SIGTERM/SIGINT path is not registered or seal/snapshot capture fails.
failed_approach: Assume normal shutdown always has time to persist state.
Call process.exit before seal callback completes.
why_failed: Crash/termination windows can destroy recovery context.
successful_recovery: Capture state/run/pending jobs and seal hash on signal.
Preserve last snapshot for later recovery verification.
prevention: Register handlers once and keep seal path side-effect bounded.

symptom: Recovery snapshot is modified or cannot be authenticated.
root_cause: Snapshot integrity hash/HMAC is missing or verification omitted.
failed_approach: Restore latest snapshot based only on recency.
Trust serialized state without integrity check.
why_failed: Recent snapshot can still be tampered/corrupt.
successful_recovery: Verify stateHash/HMAC before using snapshot.
Reject invalid snapshot and stay frozen/manual.
prevention: Bind snapshotId + stateHash with HMAC and verify before recovery.

symptom: Unexpected syscall/container breakout/gVisor bypass/Firecracker channel abuse/WASM forbidden import is detected.
root_cause: Sandbox boundary is violated or capability/isolation policy is bypassed.
failed_approach: Log and continue execution.
Treat escape event as ordinary application error.
why_failed: Escape compromises authority boundary and potentially Core/Vault integrity.
successful_recovery: Record CRITICAL escape event.
Invoke containment callback; quarantine/kill/freeze according to governing law.
prevention: Keep escape detector outside guest authority and wire event to containment.

symptom: Capability becomes active/anchored without required static verifier + quorum path.
root_cause: Admission stage is skipped or observed implementation status model is treated as equivalent to source FSM.
failed_approach: Promote REVIEWED directly to production authority because code enum lacks QUORUM_SIGNED/ACTIVE.
Use staticVerify alone as sufficient admission.
why_failed: Source governance requires hybrid deterministic verification plus human/quorum policy gate.
successful_recovery: Keep capability non-active until source-required stages are satisfied or authoritative spec changes.
Record rejection reason code.
prevention: Audit source FSM vs implementation enum explicitly; never silently normalize them.

symptom: Observed AppSpec registration creates ACTIVE directly while canonical source lifecycle requires build/seal/deploy stages.
root_cause: Implementation status enum and canonical lifecycle FSM are conflated.
failed_approach: Treat AppSpec.status as the canonical FSM because it exists in code.
Rewrite source lifecycle around implementation convenience.
why_failed: Implementation existence does not supersede source authority.
successful_recovery: Keep observed status model separate.
Require future compliance audit/repair before claiming lifecycle conformance.
prevention: Namespace implementation-only status models separately from canonical FSMs.

symptom: GameSpec creation uses randomBytes() when caller omits worldSeed.
root_cause: Convenience random seed path enters a domain that source requires deterministic authoritative numeric/RNG semantics.
failed_approach: Assume cryptographic RNG is acceptable because it is high quality.
Treat random worldSeed generation as deterministic merely because seed is later persisted.
why_failed: Authoritative replay requires explicit deterministic seed provenance/binding; CSPRNG generation may be acceptable only if source law explicitly authorizes the boundary.
successful_recovery: Do not declare compliance yet.
Audit whether seed generation occurs outside authoritative deterministic boundary or require explicit supplied/anchored seed.
prevention: Keep RNG source explicit in GameSpec contract and proof obligations.

symptom: Safe Brain/high-level AI overrides a Fast Brain HALT or safety kernel decision.
root_cause: Safety dominance/independent override boundary is implemented as advisory rather than authoritative.
failed_approach: Let high-confidence model decision clear a HALT.
Route all safety through high-level AI/ROS only.
why_failed: RCL source requires independent fail-safe dominance.
successful_recovery: HALT remains immutable downstream.
Independent safety kernel/MCU stops actuation.
prevention: Treat safety result as overriding control authority, not recommendation.

symptom: Old green/local evidence is cited as proof for a newer HEAD.
root_cause: Evidence freshness/revision binding is ignored.
failed_approach: Promote historical green Actions run to current PASS.
Treat local supplemental PASS on older commit as deployment proof.
why_failed: Evidence proves only the exact build/environment/revision it observed.
successful_recovery: Mark evidence STALE/BLOCKED for current HEAD.
Re-run required proof on exact current commit/environment.
prevention: Every evidence record must carry source_revision/environment/observed_at/freshness.

symptom: Directive dispatch and worker stale-time validation require TSA batch time, but no production TSA injection path is observed before those consumers execute.
root_cause: Queue stale TTL was correctly moved off host-clock/logical-tick semantics to currentTsaBatchTimeMs(), but the production web bootstrap and direct worker startup paths do not provision a verified TSA batch; observed injectTsaBatchTime callers are test-only.
failed_approach: Replace Date.now/currentTick stale-time use with a fail-closed TSA consumer without simultaneously wiring the production trust-boundary producer.
Repair failing tests by injecting TSA only in test setup and treat that as production integration proof.
why_failed: A fail-closed consumer with no production authority source makes the authoritative queue unavailable rather than deterministically timed.
Test-only injection proves API behavior, not runtime provenance or startup wiring.
successful_recovery: Add an explicit verified production TSA ingress before queue producer/worker elapsed-time decisions.
Keep missing TSA fail-closed and do not restore host-clock fallback.
Prove positive and negative production-like queue paths and bind DOC-E E7 evidence to the exact revision.
regression_tests: Production-like worker startup without test hooks must fail closed when TSA evidence is absent.
Production-like directive dispatch/consume must succeed only after verified TSA injection.
Replay with the same TSA batches must reproduce elapsed-time decisions.
prevention: Every authoritative elapsed-time consumer must have a traced producer/trust-boundary edge in the implementation map.
Do not accept test-only authority injection as runtime wiring evidence.

context: Current-build validation image versus advisory Phase-F governance
symptom: Railway validation can fail the current-build Docker image because experimental/Phase-F checks are hard RUN steps even though the canonical GitHub workflow marks Phase-F experimental validation advisory.
root_cause: Validation planes encode different authority: Dockerfile hard-gates test:experimental/check:phase-f while deploy.yml declares the experimental job continue-on-error.
failed_approach: Assume every validation command belongs in one blocking Docker build.
Let deployment mechanics silently promote advisory experimental scope into current-build release authority.
why_failed: Validation topology must preserve the authoritative scope classification.
An advisory-scope regression can otherwise block DOC-C current-build evidence without an authority change.
successful_recovery: Split advisory experimental validation from blocking current-build proof, or formally promote scope through the authoritative design before making it blocking.
Keep advisory failures visible with separate status/evidence rather than suppressing them.
regression_tests: Validation-topology contract asserting advisory Phase-F cannot fail the current-build blocking lane.
prevention: Encode validation authority class explicitly per gate.
Reject unreviewed promotion from advisory to blocking caused only by CI/Docker layout.

symptom: A green commit status context exists for a validation service whose exact-commit Railway deployment is SKIPPED rather than executed successfully.
root_cause: Status color/context is treated as sufficient evidence without binding it to an exact executed deployment artifact, commit hash, terminal result and environment identity.
failed_approach: Count a green provider status label as exact-head PASS.
Ignore SKIPPED deployment state because another status surface is green.
why_failed: SKIPPED proves no execution of the required validation workload.
Evidence proves only the exact artifact/revision/environment that actually ran.
successful_recovery: Require exact deployment_id + commit_hash + terminal SUCCESS + environment identity before promoting a validation claim to PASS.
Classify SKIPPED, stale and unbound green contexts as non-proof.
regression_tests: Evidence freshness/verifier test must reject SKIPPED deployment even when commit status is success.
Evidence collector must reject status without exact executed artifact binding.
prevention: Never derive release truth from status color alone.
Store deployment identity and verifier terminal state in evidence records.

symptom: All 1130 measured tests pass, but exact-head validation still fails because packages/core branch coverage is 83.13% against a 90% gate; tick.ts is 79.16% branch coverage.
root_cause: Defensive time-authority branches added/changed around range, regression and overflow handling are not all exercised by negative-path tests.
failed_approach: Treat a fully green functional test count as sufficient release evidence when the configured coverage gate remains red.
Modify production logic merely to improve coverage percentages.
why_failed: The release gate explicitly requires every standard Core coverage metric to meet 90%.
Coverage debt around fail-closed authority guards leaves critical failure behavior insufficiently exercised.
successful_recovery: Add targeted negative-path tests for uncovered Core branches before changing production logic.
Re-run test:coverage and check:coverage on the exact revision and accept only observed aggregate PASS.
regression_tests: Remaining vnext-state-matrix optional/no-transition guard branch where semantically legal.
prevention: Pair fail-closed invariant changes with negative-path branch tests in the same change set.
Do not declare exact-head validation success from test counts before post-test gates complete.
